This [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] '''official''' was a high-ranking member of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Golden Age of the Old Republic]]. Around [[987 BBY]], four [[Meerian/Legends|Meerian]] brothers, including [[Salto Zendar]], attempted to capture the official. However, their plan went badly, and two of the brothers were [[Death/Legends|killed]], one was captured, and Salto Zendar fled to a [[Hospital (Bandomeer)|hospital]] on [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]] to receive treatment for his critical injuries. As a result, the Banking Clan put a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Zendar, calling several [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to hunt Zendar down and [[Skirmish in the Bandomeer hospital|attempt]] to capture him. However, during the ensuing battle, Zendar was killed, along with four bounty hunters and several hospital staffers.
